class.name: JarVoxelUniverse
class.brief_description: Engine singleton: the shared clock, the celestial bodies and their gravity.
class.description: Keeps universe time, moves every [JarBodyOrbit] and spins every [JarCelestialBody] to it at the end of each physics frame (after all other nodes, so moved colliders are in place for the next frame), and answers gravity queries. Use it as [code]JarVoxelUniverse[/code] from scripts. Time is an integer count of physics ticks times [code]jar_voxel_terrain/universe/time_scale[/code], plus [code]universe/start_time[/code]: orbits and spin are functions of it, so they never drift and are the same on every machine with the same tick. Physics runs in the frame of the [i]anchor[/i]: the body whose gravity dominates at the first [JarVoxelViewer] (else the camera), or [method set_anchor_override]. With [code]gravity/drive_space_gravity[/code] on, the physics space's default gravity points at the anchor (inverse square from its center), so plain [RigidBody3D]s and [method CharacterBody3D.get_gravity] need no [Area3D]. Without bodies the project's gravity is restored. All of this runs only in the game, not in the editor.

method.name: get_anchor
method.description: The body whose frame physics runs in (see the description).

method.name: get_anchor_override
method.description: The anchor set with [method set_anchor_override], or [code]null[/code].

method.name: get_bodies
method.description: All celestial bodies in the tree.

method.name: get_dominant_body
method.description: The body pulling hardest at [param global_position], or [code]null[/code] without bodies.

method.name: get_gravity
method.description: Gravity at [param global_position]. With [code]gravity/physical_strength[/code] on: the sum of all bodies' pull, minus the pull the anchor itself falls with (so far bodies only add their tides). Off: only the dominant body's pull. Without bodies: the project's gravity.

method.name: get_up
method.description: Up at [param global_position]: away from the same pulls as [method get_gravity] (in the anchor's frame other bodies only add their tides), each weighted by its strength to the power [code]gravity/up_sharpness[/code], so the dominant body decides and a nearby moon does not tilt the ground. [param fallback] where there is no pull.

method.name: has_bodies
method.description: Whether any [JarCelestialBody] is in the tree.

method.name: set_anchor_override
method.description: Forces the anchor; [code]null[/code] chooses it automatically again.

method.name: set_ticks
method.description: Sets the tick count (e.g. from a server or a save game). Bodies move to the new time on the next physics frame.
